For purposes of this chapter: 6 a. “Department” means the department of agriculture and land 7 stewardship. 8 b. “Federal Acts” means the Federal Meat Inspection Act 9 approved March 4, 1907, 34 Stat. 1260, as amended by the 10 Wholesome Meat Act, 81 Stat. 584, and the Federal Poultry 11 Products Inspection Act approved August 28, 1957, 71 Stat. 441, 12 as amended by the Wholesome Poultry Products Act, 82 Stat. 791. 13 c. “Slaughter establishment” means a person engaged in the 14 business of slaughtering live animals or receiving or buying 15 live animals for slaughter and who is subject to inspection by 16 the United States department of agriculture under either of the 17 federal Acts, or by the department. 18 2. The department shall not issue a license for a person to 19 establish, conduct, or maintain a slaughter establishment in 20 this state without a license issued under chapter 189A. 21 3.
